reviews.title: Poor Service with Quality issues in the product
reviews.body: I have pathetic experience so far. First of the lock installation happened after more than a week. Secondly just within a week, the lock started malfunctioning (The lock and unlock functions) are not happening but button press or by face recognition, it is only happening happening mechanically through the lever. This is happening very frequently. The support model is very poor, every time a new person asks for video/photo and the poor guy in service seems to be lone guy handling 60-70 casses alone and can't turn up before 4-5 days conraising complaint.
